Interface ImportOrchestrator.ImportCallbacks

All Known Implementing Classes:
ImportJobRegistry.Job
Enclosing class:
ImportOrchestrator
public static interface ImportOrchestrator.ImportCallbacks
All UI notification points for a single import run.

Methods are called on the import-pipeline thread (except onNoFiles(), which runs on the thread that called ImportOrchestrator.process(List, ImportOrchestrator.ImportCallbacks)), so implementations must be thread-safe. No callback depends on the logged-in user.
